summary: The algebraic node folds onto the three CLOSED TFAE families by pure composition with zero new lemmas: MPL/IPL/CPL.hilbert_alg_completeness are already stated as 'node 1 of the closed TFAE ↔ GHAValid/HAValid/BAValid', so each fold is a single `tfae_have 1 ↔ 4 := <completeness theorem>`. All three folds were compiled verbatim against the live build with no errors, no warnings, no sorries, and axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. Context-based folds are technically feasible (also compiled) but rejected: strong algebraic completeness is theory-generic over generalized Heyting algebras for all three logics, so a CPL context node would say 'true in every GHA modelling the classical axiom theory' rather than 'valid in every Boolean algebra'; making it tier-matched needs HeytingAlgebra/BooleanAlgebra instances on RelLindenbaumAlgebra, which carries only a GHA instance. Recommendation: closed families only, three new theorems in their own section, with the closed-only decision recorded in the module docstring.
